This is its off side: the front-end lane (fe in the [lane] line, decode= in the [lane-fe] line, FE_SPLIT is on) in live play against the on side (d1 / any tour run with MSC_VGX_FE_SPLIT=1), the game thread and core 1 load; the [fepar] line of the on side gives jobs, vertices, worker busy and join wait per picture. Expected: fe about 2 ms lower in play (estimate from the decode scope 1.9-2.7 ms and the soft-transform scope 0.3 ms of the s28i-fe lanes, less the overhead); keep it on unless the on side is slower, faults, or a [hitch] appears.
